title: SCT_Tech Enablement_AI Architect_Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**SCT\-Tech Enablement \- Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 AI Architect\- SC products: We are seeking an experienced Supply Chain AI Solution Architect to join our Digital Supply Chain Team. This hybrid role combines enterprise AI architecture, Supply Chain taxonomies and knowledge graph, product thinking, and client advisory to translate business needs into secure, scalable solutions that deliver measurable value.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to identify AI opportunities and translate requirements into scalable AI solution architectures.
* Design and architect enterprise\-grade AI applications leveraging LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG, and Multimodal AI patterns.
* Define end\-to\-end AI solution architectures, including model selection, data retrieval strategy, orchestration frameworks, deployment models, and integration patterns.
* Design and implement advanced prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and memory management strategies.
* Architect hybrid retrieval solutions using vector search, semantic search, GraphRAG, SQL\-based retrieval, and vectorless approaches.
* Design and implement MCP\-based integrations with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and business systems.
* Establish AI platform standards covering observability, evaluation frameworks, LLMOps, monitoring, governance, performance optimization, and cost management.
* Define AI security architectures addressing prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized tool access, jailbreak attempts, and AI\-specific threats.
* Ensure compliance with Responsible AI principles, privacy regulations, governance requirements, and security standards.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical assessments, proof\-of\-concepts, and production\-readiness evaluations.
* Drive AI adoption across business and technology teams through workshops, technical leadership, and stakeholder engagement.
* Mentor AI engineers, architects, and developers while defining best practices, reusable frameworks, and reference architectures.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends to drive continuous innovation.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, data engineering, enterprise architecture, or related technology domains.
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, Generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, embeddings, reranking, and vector databases.
* Strong knowledge of AI agent architectures, multi\-agent systems, tool calling, memory strategies, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Proficiency in Python, API development, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform and their AI services.
* Strong understanding of databases, data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Practical experience with MCP, REST APIs, JSON\-RPC, OAuth, and secure integration frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, observability, LLMOps, and AI cost optimization.
* Understanding of model fine\-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, model routing, quantization, and inference optimization techniques.
* Experience with multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, SQL agents, and advanced retrieval architectures.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, architecture documentation, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on delivering business outcomes.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or equivalent orchestration platforms.
* Experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face, or similar AI ecosystems.
* Familiarity with vector databases and search platforms such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Neo4j.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, vLLM, Langfuse, Ragas, DeepEval, and AI platform engineering practices.
* Understanding of AI governance and security frameworks, including NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI Security, ISO/IEC 42001, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience leading enterprise AI transformation initiatives, Centers of Excellence (CoE), or AI capability building programs.
* Exposure to MLOps, DataOps, and enterprise deployment strategies for scalable AI solutions.
* Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and presenting architecture roadmaps, AI strategies, and business cases.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Product Architect
description:
**About KeyValue** 




  





 KeyValue is a premier global AI\-driven product development hub, dedicated to transforming ideas into scalable and impactful software products. With expertise across diverse industries, we deliver high\-quality solutions with the power of AI and automation. As an AI\-first organisation, we strive to push the boundaries of technology, offering accelerated, flexible and cost\-effective product development.
 



  





 We have ideated, conceived, strategized and built some of the globe’s most innovative Fintech, Payments, Financial Services, Digital Commerce, Madtech, Edtech, Socialtech, Logistics, High Technology, Blockchain, Crypto, NFT and Healthcare companies, helping them conceive, scale, pivot and enhance their businesses.
 



  





 KeyValue’s mission is to be the world’s most trusted product development hub – delivering high\-value outcomes for start\-ups \& scale\-ups – with a talented skilled team – in a thriving and inclusive culture.
 



 We're looking for a
 **Product Architect** 
 to own the technical direction of our products end to end from the first architecture decision to systems running reliably at scale. You'll set the technical bar, make the hard calls on architecture and technology and lead engineers through complex problems. Just as important: you'll be the person who spots the problem early
 *and* 
 brings the solution, working shoulder to shoulder with product, engineering and business teams.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  




* Own product architecture from concept and technology choices all the way through to systems running in production at scale.
* Translate product and business requirements into clear technical designs covering system architecture, APIs, data models, integrations and infrastructure.
* Make and defend key architectural decisions while weighing performance, security, reliability, maintainability and cost.
* Stay hands\-on by contributing to critical design and coding decisions rather than just diagrams.
* Catch architectural risks and bottlenecks early and drive the fixes before they become blockers.
* Lead engineers through hard technical problems and keep architecture consistent across teams.
* Run architecture, design and code reviews and raise the engineering bar through best practices and mentoring.
* Evaluate AI, automation and emerging tech for real product use, focusing on signal rather than hype.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* 6\+ years of experience in building and shipping software products, with strong hands\-on engineering depth.
* Hands\-on experience building AI/LLM\-enabled products or working with AI\-assisted development.
* Strong expertise in software architecture, system design, design patterns and data structures and algorithms.
* Proven experience with microservices, distributed systems, event\-driven and high\-availability architectures.
* Strong in one or more backend languages such as Java, Python, Node.js, Go, Scala, or Rust.
* Solid experience with relational and NoSQL databases, API design across REST and GraphQL and system integrations.
* Hands\-on with AWS, Azure, or GCP, along with Docker, Kubernetes and cloud\-native patterns.
* Good grasp of DevOps, CI/CD, observability, testing and production reliability.
* A track record of turning ambiguous requirements into clear technical direction and getting a team to rally behind it.
* A sharp communicator who can explain trade\-offs to engineers, product and business teams alike.

title: SAP Application Delivery Lead-Application Architect
description:

 SAP Application Delivery Lead / Application Architect
   

  

**Job Title:**
 SAP Application Delivery Lead / Application Architect
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 The SAP Application Delivery Lead / Application Architect will provide technical delivery leadership and architecture direction for large\-scale SAP transformation programs, including S/4HANA migration initiatives, enterprise integration, application modernization, and global delivery execution. The role requires significant SAP technology experience, strong stakeholder management, and the ability to translate business priorities into scalable, secure, and outcome\-focused SAP solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Provide leadership for global SAP application delivery across major transformation workstreams, including S/4HANA migration, integration, modernization, deployment, and stabilization.
* Establish architecture direction for enterprise SAP solutions across S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, SuccessFactors, HCM, and related non\-SAP platforms.
* Provide delivery governance, technical decision leadership, and direction across matrixed global teams, vendors, and senior stakeholders.


**Key responsibilities include:**
**Delivery \& Program Management**
* Develop and manage SAP technical delivery plans across global programs, with accountability for execution quality, milestone discipline, and alignment to business outcomes.
* Lead technical workstreams responsible for custom development, integrations, environments, deployments, production readiness, and stabilization.
* Define release strategy, cutover approach, governance routines, escalation pathways, and delivery risk mitigation plans.


**SAP Architecture \& Integration**
* Design scalable SAP architecture patterns that support Clean Core principles, extensibility, integration reuse, security, and long\-term maintainability.
* Provide architecture leadership across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Integration Suite, SAP BTP, SuccessFactors, SAP HCM, APIs, IDocs, and non\-SAP integrations.
* Support modernization decisions that reduce technical debt, improve platform resilience, and enable enterprise\-scale SAP transformation outcomes.


**Application Development \& Support**
* Oversee SAP application design, build, testing, deployment, and support with clear quality gates and accountability across delivery teams.
* Lead technical reviews, performance analysis, defect triage, root\-cause resolution, and production readiness assessments for critical SAP capabilities.
* Ensure production support and warranty operations meet business continuity, service quality, and incident resolution expectations.


**Stakeholder \& Client Management**
* Partner with business leaders, technology executives, vendors, and delivery teams to align architecture decisions with program objectives and enterprise standards.
* Lead executive\-level solution reviews, requirement alignment sessions, technical steering discussions, and delivery status communications.
* Address escalations, change impacts, architectural trade\-offs, and delivery commitments through clear ownership and evidence\-based decision making.


**Leadership \& People Management**
* Lead matrixed global delivery teams across architecture, development, integration, testing, deployment, and support functions.
* Develop technical talent, strengthen delivery standards, and promote reusable methods, knowledge sharing, and architecture discipline across teams.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 The role requires sound judgment across architecture, delivery, risk, and stakeholder decisions in a matrixed global environment. The candidate will be expected to evaluate trade\-offs across SAP S/4HANA, integration, SAP BTP, Clean Core, security, performance, and delivery timelines while making evidence\-based decisions that protect business outcomes and enterprise standards.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* 15\+ years of SAP technology experience, including senior accountability for technical delivery, architecture governance, and global transformation execution.
* Proven experience across full\-cycle SAP implementations, S/4HANA migrations, global rollouts, and complex application modernization programs.
* Deep understanding of SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, event\-driven integration, SAP BTP, Clean Core principles, and side\-by\-side extensibility.
* Experience with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) and related enterprise compliance requirements.
* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and leadership skills in matrixed global environments.


**Supervision Responsibilities:**
 The role will provide technical leadership and delivery direction across matrixed global teams, including architects, developers, integration specialists, testing teams, vendors, and support resources. Responsibilities include coaching senior technical talent, strengthening architecture and delivery practices, and developing reusable capabilities that improve execution quality across programs.
   

  

**Other Requirements:**
 Travel may be required up to 10% based on business needs.
   

  

**Job Requirements:**
**To qualify, candidates must have:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics \& Communication Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years in SAP technical roles, including 5\+ years leading application delivery, architecture, integration, or development teams.
* Demonstrated leadership of large\-scale SAP transformation programs, including S/4HANA migration, global rollout, integration, cutover, and stabilization responsibilities.
* Hands\-on knowledge of SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, SAP BTP, Clean Core, side\-by\-side extensibility, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) and enterprise compliance\-related SAP capabilities.
* Ability to communicate clearly with executive stakeholders, business leaders, vendors, and global delivery teams.
* Preferred certifications include ABAP on Cloud Backend Developer, SAP CPI Integration Developer, and SAP Signavio Process Management Consultant.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we are committed to helping our people develop future\-focused skills and build meaningful careers in a diverse, inclusive, and globally connected environment.
   

  

* Career development: EY provides opportunities to develop future\-focused skills and gain experiences that support long\-term career growth.
* Flexible work arrangements: EY flexible work policies are designed to support balance, trust, and autonomy, subject to business and role requirements.
* Benefits: EY offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support wellbeing, flexibility, and personal and professional priorities.
* Compensation: A competitive compensation package will be offered, including salary, benefits, and potential performance\-based incentives.

 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

description:
**Job Title: Infrastructure Cloud Architect (Networking Engineer)** 




**Location** 
 : Kochi, Bangalore, Hyderabad
 



**Shift:** 
 24/7 rotational shift
 



**Experience Level: 10\-15yrs** 




  





**Job Description** 




 Infrastructure Architects are the key link between Kyndryl and our clients. You’re in a technical leadership role, uniting and guiding stakeholders from clients, governance, and project executives to delivery and sometimes even the vendors who work with the client. You’ll be there from the start of a project — understanding what’s needed and figuring out the best technical solution. And you’ll be there at the finish, delivering the right product on time and within budget.
 



  





 As an Infrastructure Architect, you’ll draw upon the full breadth of your talent and experience. This is a technical leadership role, so we want you to bring your vision, knowledge, and leadership to each project. To the client, you’re the subject matter expert – consulting early, gathering inputs, understanding what they need from our solution. You define what Kyndryl can do to meet this solution. You design the best solution for the job. And finally, you’re the tech leader for implementation.
 



  





 At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre\-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities.The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.
 



  





**Your future at Kyndryl** 




 This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here
 



  





**Job Qualifications** 




 You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

* Overall 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in designing, configuring, and maintaining

 , and IPAM solutions. Networking \& Security, Application \& Databases

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to interact confidently with stakeholders of all levels

* Develop, maintain, and enforce operational procedures and documentation for Azure AD management.
* Collaborate with IAM engineering and architecture teams to support the implementation of Azure AD solutions and integrations.
